name: USAspending.gov API v2 (search, recipient, references)
key_endpoints: POST /api/v2/recipient/; GET /api/v2/recipient/{id}/; POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ (subawards=true for FSRS subawards); POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_award_count/; POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_transaction/; POST /api/v2/search/spending_by_category/{cfda|recipient}/; POST /api/v2/autocomplete/cfda/; POST /api/v2/download/count/
fields_of_interest: Award ID; generated_internal_id; Recipient Name; Recipient UEI; recipient_id; Award Amount; Total Outlays; Assistance Listings; Awarding Agency/Sub Agency; Start/End Date; def_codes; Sub-Award ID/Amount/Date; Sub-Awardee Name; Sub-Recipient UEI; Prime Recipient Name; Prime Award ID
years_covered: search endpoints FY2008+ (2007-10-01 floor); downloads FY2001+
coverage_gaps: Subawards only where primes report to FSRS: SLFRF 21.027 subawards absent for DC; CoC 14.267 has 2 DC subaward rows. Award-level location filters use the current award recipient location (EFSP National Board now VA). Name-only (R-level) recipients lack UEI.
sample_request: curl -s -X POST https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"filters":{"recipient_search_text":["KMGRTKET2KJ1"],"award_type_codes":["02","03","04","05"],"time_period":[{"start_date":"2007-10-01","end_date":"2026-09-30"}]},"fields":["Award ID","Recipient Name","Award Amount","Assistance Listings"],"limit":100,"page":1,"sort":"Award Amount","order":"desc"}'
notes: Calvary UEI KMGRTKET2KJ1, DUNS 126543453; prime awards 2, FSRS subawards 1; DC target-CFDA probe 836 prime / 891 sub rows.

name: USAspending.gov award downloads (download/awards, bulk_download/awards)
rate_limit: async jobs; download/awards max 500,000 rows per file
key_endpoints: POST /api/v2/download/awards/ (advanced-search filters incl. program_numbers, recipient_locations); POST /api/v2/bulk_download/awards/ (agencies required; no program_numbers filter; prime transactions); GET /api/v2/download/status/?file_name=
fields_of_interest: assistance_award_unique_key; award_id_fain; cfda_number; recipient_uei; recipient_name; total_obligated_amount; total_outlayed_amount; period_of_performance_*; subaward_* columns
coverage_gaps: Same FSRS gaps as the search API.
notes: download_awards_calvary: finished 3 rows in 0s; bulk_download_hud_dc_fy2024: finished 658 rows in 0s

name: Federal Audit Clearinghouse API
rate_limit: 1000 requests/hour per key; 20,000 rows per request
fields_of_interest: report_id; auditee_ein; auditee_uei; audit_year; fy_end_date; total_amount_expended; federal_agency_prefix; federal_award_extension; federal_program_name; amount_expended; is_direct; is_major; passthrough_name; passthrough_id; award_reference
coverage_gaps: Only auditees over the single-audit threshold ($750k; $1M for FY beginning on/after 2024-10-01). Calvary present for audit years 2022 and 2023 only. passthrough_id often blank or 'GSA_MIGRATION'.

name: Grants.gov REST API (search2, fetchOpportunity)
rate_limit: none published; probed at 2 req/s; rows=10000 OK, rows=30000 fails (HTTP 502 / dropped connection)
key_endpoints: POST /v1/api/search2 (keyword, cfda, oppStatuses, agencies, eligibilities, fundingCategories, fundingInstruments, rows, startRecordNum); POST /v1/api/fetchOpportunity (opportunityId)
fields_of_interest: id; number; title; agencyCode; openDate; closeDate; oppStatus; docType; cfdaList; synopsis.awardCeiling/awardFloor/estimatedFunding/responseDate/applicantTypes; forecast.*; cfdas
years_covered: current posted/forecasted plus closed and archived history
coverage_gaps: Federal discretionary opportunities only; formula/pass-through funds Calvary receives via DC are not listed. Filter key is 'cfda' in production (docs say 'aln', which is ignored).

name: SAM.gov Assistance Listings data extract (CSV)
key_endpoints: GET extract URL (303 redirect to signed S3 URL); GET https://sam.gov/api/prod/sgs/v1/search/?index=cfda&q= (undocumented)
fields_of_interest: Program Number; Program Title; Popular Name; Federal Agency; Types of Assistance; Applicant Eligibility; Obligations; Website Address
coverage_gaps: Archived listings (21.019, 14.235) are absent; use USAspending autocomplete for their titles.

name: SAM.gov Entity Management API
rate_limit: per SAM.gov public docs (not verified here): 10/day without a SAM role, 1,000/day with one
fields_of_interest: ueiSAM; legalBusinessName; registrationStatus; registrationExpirationDate; physicalAddress; entityStructure
coverage_gaps: Keyless sam.gov search index (index=ei) returns exclusions only.
notes: Without key: {'entity_v3': 404, 'assistance_listings_v1': 404}. UEI already available from USAspending and FAC.

name: Treasury SLFRF public data (subaward file; quarterly reporting data)
fields_of_interest: prime_awardee_name; subawardee_name; subawardee_uei; subaward_amount; subaward_action_date; subaward_description; Project ID; Project Name; Expenditure Category; Total Cumulative Obligations/Expenditures
coverage_gaps: Subaward detail stops at 2023-06-30; project workbook has no subrecipient names.
